subject: Action required: SSO mapping and PO visibility for Ridgepoint onboarding
content:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@ridgepoint.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Reynolds <monica.reynolds@ridgepoint.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Can't see POs after accepting portal invite

Hi Chloe,

We completed the Coupa invite flow this morning but when I log in I do not see any purchase orders under the 'Orders' tab — it looks like my account is limited to the profile setup screens only. Monica (cc'd) tried from a different browser and saw the same.

Screenshot attached (portal-screenshot-err.png). Can you confirm whether our Ridgepoint account is fully linked to the PO feed or if there's an SSO/attribute step we missed? We accepted the invite via the link in the email around 08:30 PT.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Vendor Ops | Ridgepoint Logistics
Attachment: portal-screenshot-err.png (image/png)

----

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@ridgepoint.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Reynolds <monica.reynolds@ridgepoint.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't see POs after accepting portal invite

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and for the screenshot.

Quick checklist before I escalate to eng:
- Did you accept the invite with the same email that is listed on the PO (sam.patel@ridgepoint.io)?
- Are you logging in via our SSO button ("Sign in with Ridgepoint SSO") or via the email magic link?

Ben, can you look at the tenant mapping for Ridgepoint? My first guess is an SSO attribute (email vs. user.principalName) mismatch that left the account in a profile-only state. If you need the tenant id I can pull it.

Sam — if you can confirm the acceptance email and attach the signed W9 we can move this faster (Monica mentioned they have it ready).

Chloe
Chloe Martin
Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

----

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@ridgepoint.io>
Cc: Monica Reynolds <monica.reynolds@ridgepoint.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't see POs after accepting portal invite

Thanks — I pulled the onboarding logs for tenant RIDGE-1009. Two things stand out from the identity handoff this morning:

1) The SAML assertion arrived with NameID: sam.patel@ridgepoint.io but the Coupa tenant was configured to match on attribute "mail" (we typically accept either, but this tenant was set to strict matching).
2) The user was created in the portal under a shadow identity (profile-only) because the attribute mapping failed the PO-feed role assignment step (role: supplier_po_viewer).

Immediate remediation steps I applied: adjusted mapping to accept NameID OR mail, and bumped the auto-role rule to grant supplier_po_viewer when an assertion contains supplier=true. Please try logging out and back in (clear cookies) — I forced a session refresh for RIDGE-1009.

I've also pushed a ticket to Coupa support in case there are cached session tokens on their side that still show the old role. Ticket: COUPA-847192 (internal).

Ben
Ben Carter
Platform Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: (no file)

----

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@ridgepoint.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Reynolds <monica.reynolds@ridgepoint.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't see POs after accepting portal invite

Thanks Ben — I logged out, cleared cookies, and re-joined via the SSO button. I can now see the open POs list but one PO (PO-78324) shows as "permissions restricted" when I click the details. Screenshot attached.

Also attached the signed W9 as requested (Ridgepoint_W9_signed.pdf). Can you confirm we've been granted visibility for all POs tied to our vendor id?

Sam
Attachment: Ridgepoint_W9_signed.pdf (application/pdf); portal-screenshot-err.png (image/png)

----

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@ridgepoint.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Reynolds <monica.reynolds@ridgepoint.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't see POs after accepting portal invite

Great — thanks for the W9 and the quick test. Ben — can you take PO-78324 and the RIDGE-1009 mapping as a follow-on? If the PO-level permission is still blocked we should confirm: (a) vendor id on our side matches the id on the PO, and (b) there is no manual ACL applied to that PO for legal/tax hold.

Rachel, I looped you in to confirm the W9 is processed and the tax status is active for Ridgepoint (if you can mark them cleared that will unblock any manual holds).

Sam — once Ben confirms we'll post an update here and I will send a short note to your billing contact to confirm we can route the payment.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
